verdict.rationale: Replit itself functions as a coding agent (Replit Agent), and all evidence (replit-docs-12, replit-docs-16, replit-docs-20, replit-docs-35) describes Replit Agent connecting TO external MCP servers as a client — not Replit exposing itself as an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the agent-role exception, this client-side capability does not make the server axis applicable.
